name: Sis x Miko
source:
Main character's is the eldest son in the family that run a shrine. He is destined to inherit the business, but he is very worried about one thing. His twin sister shrine maidens temp him every day with their looks and occasional initiative signs. What future will he choose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是经营神社的家族中的长子。他注定要继承生意，但他很担心一件事。他的双胞胎姐妹巫女每天都用她们的外表和偶尔主动的手势来诱惑他。他会选择怎样的未来？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
